subject: Quick note about fallersfurniture.com
body:
Hi there,

Faller's has been serving Clarion since 1847 - that's a rare kind of trust to build. While looking at your site, I noticed your meta description only mentions "Clarion, PA" even though your title tag lists Clarion, Shippenville, and Knox - which means Shippenville/Knox searches may not be showing your listing as clearly as they should. I also didn't see a blog or buying-guide section, which is usually where independent furniture stores pick up steady organic traffic.

I put together a quick SEO health check covering this and a few other fixes - happy to share it, no obligation. Would that be useful?
